description: An appointment booking form composed from the SvGrid UI kit in Svelte 5: SvComboBox picks the service, SvCalendar the date in single-selection mode, SvTimePicker the slot at fifteen-minute intervals, SvButtonGroup the duration and SvNumberInput the guest count between one and twelve, with a live summary and a Book button that enables once every field is set. The same components SvGrid mounts to edit cells, arranged into a real page.
keywords: svelte calendar and time picker form

faq.question: How are the date and time combined?
faq.answer: SvCalendar reports an array of dates and the form keeps the first; SvTimePicker reports a Date holding the time. A $derived merges the two into the appointment start shown in the summary.

faq.question: How do I limit the time slots?
faq.answer: minuteInterval on SvTimePicker snaps the minutes, fifteen here. For business hours, pass min and max or filter the chosen time in the summary derivation.

faq.question: How is the Book button gated?
faq.answer: canBook is a $derived that requires a service, a date and a time; the button's disabled prop reads it, so validation is declarative.
